Choosing a torque wrench for field work

A good field torque wrench balances accuracy, durability, and weight. This article explains how to compare click-type and digital wrenches, why calibration intervals matter, and how to store a wrench so it holds its calibration between jobs.

We recommend recalibrating every twelve months or after any drop. Keep the wrench dialed down to its lowest setting during storage to relax the internal spring.
